concepts.def: V_g = -GM/r; work per unit mass to bring from infinity; always negative.
V_e = kQ/r; work per unit positive charge from infinity; defines voltage relative to reference.
Surface of constant potential; perpendicular to field lines; no work done moving along.
Field strength = -dV/dr; field points down potential gradient.
C = Q/V; SI unit farad; parallel plate C = epsilon0 A / d.
U = 1/2 C V^2 = 1/2 Q V; stored in electric field between plates.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Fields — a core area of Physics.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Fields brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Fields.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
